summary: The delivery audit after phases 5 and 6 re-read all 59 Kiln Requirements Stages criteria in four rounds, and 22 of them are still not fully built. Every gap is partial: an edge case or one variant of a criterion. Phase 7 completes the home screen's placements and the start checks they must agree with. Phase 8 completes the requirements run's controls, plan screen and stage models. The fourth round still found a new gap, so a further reading could find more; the build-and-audit cycle after phases 7 and 8 re-reads them. No criterion was changed outside the requirements, and none needed amending.

needsYou.problem: Kiln's checkpoint hook again reported "Admission lock is unresolved; retry reconciliation" (and "Admission owner-death recovery is unresolved") throughout this audit. It cut off most fourth-round assessors and some earlier ones, and at times refused the session's own commands. The likely cause: `withGate` in src/live/gate.ts holds `admission.lock` while it reads and fsync-rewrites the attempt's gate.json. That file grows with every operation (about 1 MB in this attempt, 10.9 MB in an earlier one), and every tool call of every parallel sub-agent waits on the lock, which gives up after 5 seconds.
needsYou.action: Look at gate.json growth and the 5-second admission deadline in src/live/gate.ts (live-attempts under the PRD's Kiln state directory). Many parallel sub-agents exceed that deadline, so delivery and test audits keep losing assessors.
